scenario: A node's worker is respawned (generation bump) after its first-generation worker stalled — e.g. an escalation forced a re-route to a different model class. The stale generation-1 worker later reports completion for work the kernel has already moved past. That stale completion must be refused; the node's state must stay owned by generation 2, not revert to the stale generation's report.

steps.event: node n1 dispatched at generation 1 to a sonnet worker
n1 escalates (blocker); the kernel re-routes n1 to an opus worker at generation 2
steps.expect: n1 is in-progress at generation 2; generation 1 is marked superseded

steps.event: the generation-1 worker (unaware of the re-route) reports progress: done for n1
steps.expect: the completion is refused as stale (generation mismatch) — n1's state is NOT marked done
n1 remains in-progress at generation 2, awaiting the generation-2 worker's own completion

steps.event: the generation-2 worker later reports progress: done for n1
steps.expect: this completion is accepted; n1 transitions to done at generation 2
